verdict.rationale: Glama is a SaaS platform that handles chats, uploaded documents and logged gateway calls, so user control over data retention and deletion is a fair question to ask of it. The pack shows that every gateway call is logged and that conversations can be saved and tagged. Nothing in it documents retention periods, deletion of chats, files or logs, or any user-facing retention settings. 'Private by default' concerns listing visibility, not retention.
